event_chain.summary: Hacker targets FEC website/e-filing system - method not disclosed

summary: In late October 2026, about a week before the November 3 midterm elections, the US Federal Election Commission's website was targeted by a hacker or hackers, according to an email seen by Reuters, disrupting the agency's electronic filing system for campaign finance disclosures. The FEC said the e-filing system was offline while IT staff worked to restore it; past reports remained searchable.
